newsitem.title: UK: Eurodis Electron plunges on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Eurodis Electron plunges on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Eurodis Electron plunged over 20 percent to a new year's low on Tuesday after the British electronic components and systems supplier warned first-half results would be below market expectations.

Eurodis shares led losers in pre-market dealings, touching a low of 120p before paring losses slightly to 127-1/2p, down 26-1/2p on the day. The stock was among the top five most-traded issues, with just over 84,000 shares changing hands.
Eurodis said it expected little improvement in market conditions for the second half and said its performance for the current financial year was likely to match the previous year.
The company said the global components market was facing oversupply "on a scale not seen since 1985".
